description: This file defines the JobNotFoundException class, a custom exception used within the Fineract project to indicate that a specific job resource was not found. It extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides multiple constructors for different error scenarios related to missing jobs.

classes.name: JobNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a job resource was not found, extended from AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: JobNotFoundException (String identifier)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the job with the specified identifier does not exist.

methods.name: JobNotFoundException (IdTypeResolver.IdType idType, String jobId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a formatted message indicating the job with the specified id type and job id does not exist.

methods.name: JobNotFoundException (String identifier, NoSuchJobException e)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and wraps underlying NoSuchJobException.

methods.name: JobNotFoundException (String identifier, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and wraps underlying EmptyResultDataAccessException.
